# Lelettrica di Leoni Gabriele

> E-bike rental (Flyer) and bike repairs in Dro, Trentino, on Lake Garda. Walk-in shop at Via Roma 90, 38074 Dro (TN), Italy. The site is available in Italian, English and German.

Prices and availability change over the season: read them on the bike pages, not from this file.

## Bikes for rent

- [Bikes, Italian](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/it/bikes): Flyer e-bikes and classic bikes, with daily prices
- [Bikes, English](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/en/bikes): the same list in English
- [Bikes, German](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/de/bikes): the same list in German

## Recommended routes

- [Routes, Italian](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/it/routes): rides suggested by the shop, each with a GPX track, photos and a 3D map
- [Routes, English](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/en/routes): the same routes in English
- [Routes, German](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/de/routes): the same routes in German

## About the shop

- [Home, Italian](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/it): shop, opening hours, contacts and map
- [Home, English](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/en): the same in English
- [Home, German](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/de): the same in German

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.lelettricaleoni.com/sitemap.xml): every public page, in all three languages
